scope: Exploratory tuning on the previously seen 24 evaluation tasks x 3 seeds (also used for nemotron72-known-single-v1). Not fresh generalization. Independent agents only: no shared memory, voting, CPU search, teacher or gold answers. scribe_explicit is a new, not development-selected variant; any result for it is exploratory.
method: K=8 independent agents per case, alternating scribe_full (frozen 638b9f3 worker, development-selected) and scribe_explicit (same scribe commit rule, prompt = index_explicit wording that states existing verifier rules; new module followup72b). Each agent has its own Budget(2 calls, 8192 completion tokens) and seed; no communication. Case solved if any agent plan passes the original exact verifier. All agents run to completion; size-k success uses agents 0..k-1 in this fixed order. Even agents give the homogeneous scribe_full curve k=1..4, odd agents the homogeneous scribe_explicit curve k=1..4.
seeds: agent seed = 1000*case_seed + agent_index; disjoint from single-agent seeds 1,2,3

limits.deadline_note: Safety stop above two 210 s HTTP calls; run_benchmark labels any deadline row controller_180_second_deadline regardless of the value (legacy label). An HTTP timeout is an infrastructure fault and stops new admissions.

scheduling.placement: agent j of case c runs on replica (c+j)%4; per-replica FIFO queues in case order
scheduling.concurrency_note: 6 per node keeps a full 7936-token first call near 150 s (measured ~47 tok/s at 8/node, ~118 at 1/node) under the 210 s HTTP timeout; 12/node would risk timeouts that count as infrastructure faults (pre-launch review).

primary_outcome: solved cases out of 72 with all 8 agents (mixed curve); secondary: homogeneous scribe_full and scribe_explicit curves k=1..4, per-agent success, completion tokens per solved case (all in metadata swarm_summary)
stop_policy: Controller/transport/malformed-trace/process faults or source change stop new admissions; in-flight agents finish. Deadlines are outcomes.
